title: Auðlegðarskattur: temporary net wealth tax on individuals (enacted end of 2009)
summary: A temporary tax on individuals' net wealth above ISK 75m (couples ISK 100m) in its last form; it ran from 2010 and was last assessed in 2014 on net wealth at the end of 2013. Source: the finance minister's written answer to Andrés Ingi Jónsson (154th session), which sets out the rules; althingi.is answers scripts with 403.
status: Last levied in 2014 on net wealth at the end of 2013 (finance minister's answer, 2024).

title: Svar fjármála- og efnahagsráðherra: tekjur af auðlegðarskatti (þingskjal 2266, 978. mál)
by: Sigurður Ingi Jóhannsson, finance minister, answering Andrés Ingi Jónsson
summary: Official estimate that an auðlegðarskattur on the 2013 model, with thresholds indexed, would have raised just under ISK 37bn in 2023 (reported by Vísir on 9 Sept 2024).

title: Skattar og ójöfnuður: Réttlátara og skilvirkara skattkerfi
summary: The union confederation's tax report says repeal of the auðlegðarskattur raised inequality (top 1% burden down 7.4 points) and that a sensibly designed large-estates tax could raise over ISK 20bn a year.
